name: ArAr PDF
description: Powerful offline PDF editor with page management, PDF merge, document reader, image and Word to PDF conversion, compression, and image export.
majorCapabilities: PDF page management: reorder, delete selected pages, insert blank pages, and save as a new PDF
Merge multiple PDF documents with source ordering
Convert multiple JPG/PNG images and DOCX documents to PDF offline
PDF reader with page rendering, zoom, navigation, and reading modes
Compress embedded PDF images and export pages or extracted text
Share generated documents through Android FileProvider
